# smart-trust-document-kinds

How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: `dak.coverage.smart-trust.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. Generated at publish, after the index it reads, by the DAK layer's `gen-document-kinds.ts` (`bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds`); not committed.

Part of [WHO SMART Trust](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-document-kinds`, holding `document-kinds`.
